prompt:
Design a desktop website hero screen, 16:9 landscape (1920x1080), rendered as the web page itself edge to edge (no browser window, no device frame, no mockup). This image IS the whole first viewport; nothing else appears below it.

Brand: ROOMi (ROOMiVERSE), a DJ lifestyle brand: "any ordinary space becomes your party, anywhere, with anyone". This is the hero of the "Meet ROOMi" brand page. Attached: (1) the two-wordmark graffiti logo "ROOMi ROOMi"; (2) the designer's Figma page — keep its hero idea (a crowd/concert photo with the big logo over it and a short brand story).

The hero contains ONLY:
1. The site's thin top navigation over the image: logo small at the exact center; left "MEET ROOMi" (active, underlined), "WHAT'S GOING ON", "LET'S PARTY", "SHOP"; right "CART (0)", "MY". Small white uppercase grotesk, no bar.
2. A full-bleed cinematic party photograph filling the entire screen: a packed, flash-lit house/club party crowd with raised hands, shot from behind the DJ, deep black #111111 shadows with hot pink #F71D64 and violet #C14ED4 stage light, soft haze, film grain. Darkened enough for text to read.
3. The big two-wordmark graffiti logo "ROOMi ROOMi" set LARGE in the center (about 45% of the screen width), filled with a pink-to-violet gradient (#F71D64 to #C14ED4) with a faint glow, "ROOMiVERSE" in thin, widely tracked white caps tucked beside it.
4. Under the logo, a short brand intro in white, centered, two lines at reading size: "Anyone, anywhere — your own musical universe." and in Korean "어디서 누구와 함께하든, 평범한 공간이 파티가 됩니다."
5. At the bottom center, a small scroll indicator: a thin white chevron with "SCROLL" in tiny caps.

Nothing else: no buttons, no cards, no About Us. One dominant move: the giant gradient logo over the crowd.
